v19_bind.description: Starts a session and binds the caller as operator. Expect an OPERATOR record with action=bound, your name and UUID.

v19_placeholders.description: Uses all three operator placeholders. Expect the BUNDLE_STEP records to show your real name, UUID and selector, a pig named after you, and every command succeeding.

v19_unbound_control.description: Stops the session, which unbinds the operator, then uses a placeholder. Expect an ERROR with devtool.placeholder.unbound and the bundle halting before its second marker.

v19_cleanup.description: Removes the pig named after the operator, by type and radius so no name is needed.
